60-yard shuttle sprint (5 yards, 10 yards, 15 yards)  
Max-reps [bar dips](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-bar-dip)

**♀ 55 lb ♂ 75 lb**

sections.section_content:
AMRAP in 20 minutes:

* Run 400 meters
* Max reps **Strict Pull-ups**
section_notes: This is a strict variation of the classic 'Nicole' workout.
If unable to perform 7 strict reps, start with strict until failure, then finish with kipping.

metadata.raw_content:
**Strict Nicole**

Complete as many rounds as possible in 20 minutes of:  
Run 400 meters  
Max-reps [strict pull-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-strict-pull-up)

Post number of pull-ups completed for each round to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/231007).

Compare to [190607](https://www.crossfit.com/190607).
***

**Scaling:**   
This variation of the classic workout, Nicole, calls for strict pull-ups. If you have strict pull-ups, but are unable to perform at least 7 reps, begin each set with strict pull-ups until failure, and then stay on the bar for kipping pull-ups. If you do not yet have strict pull-ups, one option is to use a band and perform banded strict pull-ups.  

**Intermediate option:**   
Complete as many rounds as possible in 20 minutes of:  
Run 400 meters  
Max-reps strict pull-ups + [kipping](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-kipping-pull-up)   

*If you have strict pull-ups, but are unable to perform at least 7 reps, begin each set with strict pull-ups until failure, and then stay on the bar for kipping pull-ups. 

**Beginner option:**   
Complete as many rounds as possible in 20 minutes of:  
Run 400 meters  
Max-reps [banded strict pull-ups](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q0wGtLi0-K8)

metadata.raw_content:
[Guest Programmer](https://www.crossfit.com/guest-programming-on-crossfit-com) - Ben Smith: Oct. 9-22, 2023.    
***
4 rounds for time of:  
[Row](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/rowing) 500 meters   
50 [double-unders](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-double-under)  
5x [1 [wall walk](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-wall-walk) + 1 [strict wall-facing handstand push-up](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-chest-to-wall-handstand-push-up)]

Then,   
200-ft overhead walking lunge

♀ 25-lb plate ♂ 45-lb plate  

Post time to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/231009).  
***

**Full Session:**  
If you want to perform the additional elements Ben would program for CrossFit Krypton, begin today's session with heavy shoulder presses. Build up to a heavy set of 3 for the day in a total of 5 sets. Then, complete the 4-round workout.  

[Shoulder press](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-shoulder-press) 3-3-3-3-3 reps 

Post loads and time to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/231000).    
*** 
**Scaling:**  
If you do not have double-unders, read “[Jump Rope Basics](https://library.crossfit.com/premium/pdf/62_07_Jump_Rope_Basics.pdf)” and practice single-unders. Modify the handstand push-up to a pushing exercise that challenges your current abilities while allowing you to keep working for 5 sets without hitting failure. 

**Intermediate option:**  
4 rounds for time of:  
Row 500 meters   
50 double-unders  
5x [1 wall walk + 1 strict wall-facing handstand push-up to 2 AbMats]

Then,   
200-ft overhead walking lunge 

**♀ 15-lb plate ♂ 35-lb plate**  

**Beginner option:**    
**3 rounds** for time of:  
Row **300 meters**   
50 **single**-unders  
5x **[1 push-up + 1 wall walk]**  

Then,   
200-ft walking lunge **(unweighted)**
